method: Adlard-style catalogue rebuilt under shuffled 5-fold (their protocol) vs patient-grouped 5-fold (ours, E03), identical 11,868 samples. Ghosh 632 isolates NOT reconstructable from local data (Tables S9/S10 absent) -> not compared.
interpretation: Shuffled sens_firm 0.7955 vs patient-grouped 0.7924 (delta +0.0031). Patient grouping is the stricter, leakage-controlled protocol. Ghosh comparison infeasible (data not local).
caveats: Shuffled CV can leak related germs across folds (optimistic). Grouped controls patient duplicates but not clones/outbreaks fully. Ghosh omitted honestly; NEVER cross-cohort AUC.
supports: Same-data head-to-head vs Adlard under both protocols (P-G7).
